column3: Close to the Hebrew; “let them give thanks… his covenant loyalty” is rendered “Oh, that men would give thanks… for His goodness.”
Close to the Hebrew; לִמְלֵחָה (“into salt land”) is rendered “into barrenness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they made fruit of produce” is rendered “they may yield a fruitful harvest.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “far.”
Close to the Hebrew; יְשָׁרִים (“the upright”) is rendered “The righteous.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the acts of covenant loyalty” is rendered “the lovingkindness.”
